scope: Independent bounded arithmetic/schema review; no worker, model, source or policy modifications

finding.title: Join projected economics to the actual ledger and recompute fee errors
finding.observed: Projection fees and utilities are recalculated internally, but conditional metadata is optional on learned-policy trades; its quantity, price and notional are not independently joined to actual trade/source values. Realized-minus-projected fee fields are summed without recalculation.
finding.impact: A self-consistent projection attached to the wrong trade, missing learned-policy projection, or erroneous stored fee-error field can pass this analyzer, undermining the declared projected-versus-realized diagnostic even when account PnL remains correctly reconciled.
recommended_checks: Require conditional metadata on learned-policy trades
Assert fill quantity equals executed quantity and does not exceed reference quantity
Check reference price against signal close and fill price against entry close; each notional equals quantity times price
Check frozen mu and downside agree between reference and fill
Check projected sale notional equals N*(1+mu)
Recalculate realized total fees less each projected total fee before summing errors
finding.resolution_at_write: Resolved by owner; independently reread the final joins and arithmetic. The initial finding text is retained as review history.

reviewed_consistent: Decimal fees match frozen 40bps and moomoo scenario including price threshold, component minima and sell levy
Entry is next close, exit is entry plus declared horizon, quantity is positive whole shares
Source notional and adjusted sale checks agree with engine convention within declared numeric tolerance
Prior account helper reconciles full account PnL, fees, trade counts, cash, period returns, exposure and drawdown; incomplete paths stay invalid
Eighteen-account scope and paired comparisons preserve every declared account
Launcher runs analysis only after successful study exit and records both exit statuses
limits: Static review does not validate unavailable account results
No source-action completeness or profitability claim
No waiting for future accounts or additional broad validation initiated

verified: Fill quantity is executed quantity and bounded above by reference quantity
Both projection prices and notionals join to the corresponding source close and actual ledger
Frozen mu/downside match each other and the exact hash-verified saved forecast array
Both realized-minus-projected fee fields are independently recomputed before aggregation

source_hash_timing: Hashes were captured when initial evidence was written, concurrently with the owner fix; they do not establish an immutable pre-fix snapshot. The followup hash identifies the final reread source.

action_attribution_followup.inventory_scope: Full USD source-matched provider split-labelled inventory, not only previously held crossings; not ordinary dividends or exhaustive corporate actions
verified: Actual source_hashes schema is list of symbol/sha256 records; event source_sha256 keys and values all join
ISO session comparison excludes action on entry session and includes action on exit session
Multiple events per trade preserve all event IDs while counting trade PnL once
Crossing signed PnL sums all crossing trades; absolute PnL share uses sum(abs(crossing net))/sum(abs(all net)) and is undefined for zero denominator
Known-issue count and signed PnL filter union membership once per crossing trade
No trades are deleted or corrected and source-lookback/dividend limitations are explicit
